title: Finite affine hashing isolates bounded witness words
claims: AffineHashIsolationBound proves that some output width no more than the input dimension plus two has at least one eighth successful affine seeds.
BoundedWordAffineIsolation proves the same isolation guarantee for length-bounded Boolean words via an explicit injective padding map.
The result is a finite uniform-seed count. No randomized or deterministic algorithm for SAT is claimed.
P_subset_NP is independently checked using pinned definitions.
